timeline.title: Loved Through the Ages
items: Side by side
In the Middle East, a person was laid to rest with a hand gently resting on a puppy.
Ancient Egypt
Mourned like family
Herodotus wrote that when a family cat died, the whole household shaved their eyebrows.
Ancient Rome
Words in stone
Romans carved loving epitaphs for their pets, praising their gentleness, loyalty and sweet ways.
A garden of goodbyes
A small pet cemetery began in London's Hyde Park, with tiny headstones for much loved friends.
today: Not in the history books. But in our hearts, for {years} wonderful years and every year after.

letters.title: What the World Has Said About Love That Stays
items: All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
Helen Keller
Unable are the Loved to die, for Love is Immortality.
Emily Dickinson
To live in hearts we leave behind is not to die.
Thomas Campbell, Hallowed Ground
Love leaves a memory no one can steal.
A traditional saying
letters.hand: They all say it beautifully. We just say: thank you, {who}. You are still here.

facts.title: The Science of How Pets Love Us
items: heart
The love hormone
When a dog and its human gaze at each other, oxytocin, the bonding hormone, rises in both.
eye
The slow blink
A slow blink from a cat is a sign of trust and affection, often given only to their people.
music
They knew your voice
Pets can pick out their own human's voice from the voices of strangers.
smile
They read our faces
Dogs can tell a happy face from an angry one, and many pets come close when we are sad.
pulse
A calmer heart
Time with a much loved animal can lower stress and ease feelings of loneliness.
star
Love that lasts
Missing a pet deeply is completely natural. It shows how strong the bond really was.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It cannot measure how much {who} was loved.

note.title: What we believe love leaves behind
paras: We make magazines for a living, and some we make very gently. This was one of them.
We believe a pet never really leaves. They stay in the sunny spot by the door, in the habits we picked up from them, in the way we still smile at the silly things they did.
{who}, someone wanted your story kept safe. Not on a card that fades, but in pages full of you: your face, your favourite places, the little things that made you, you.
That someone is {from}. And from everything they told us, you were loved completely, and you still are.
note.wish: Thank you, {who}. For every single day. Forever loved.
